# LocalCreators

> LocalCreators is an Australian self-serve platform where small businesses hire bundles of local nano creators (1,000–10,000 followers) for a flat monthly price. Launching soon in Sydney, Australia.

## What it is

- A small business (cafe, salon, gym, boutique, restaurant) buys a bundle of 10 local nano creators for $79–$99/month.
- Creators post about the business to audiences in the same suburb or city — people who can actually walk into the shop.
- Matching is suburb-level: creators are verified as local by where their audience lives, not just where the creator lives.
- Automatic disclosure compliance is built in for Australian advertising rules.

## Why local nano creators

- Nano creators (1K–10K followers) have a median engagement rate of 2.1%, versus 0.5% for mega creators (Virev 2026 study of 391,731 Instagram creators).
- Median sponsored post cost: $110 for nano creators versus $636 for micro creators (Virev 2026).
- For comparison, Posted charges $500/month with a $5,000 contest minimum (Posted help centre, October 2026).
- Australia has 2,656,469 small businesses (ABS, June 2025).
